title: A Heartbreaking Work of Staggering Genius
author: Dave Eggers
description: After losing both parents to cancer within five weeks of each other, Dave Eggers raises his eight-year-old brother alone. A raw, funny, and formally inventive memoir about grief, parenthood, and the audacity it takes to keep going.

title: Braiding Sweetgrass
author: Robin Wall Kimmerer
description: A botanist and member of the Citizen Potawatomi Nation weaves together indigenous wisdom and Western science to make the case that plants are not passive — they are our oldest teachers, and the natural world has much to say if we learn to listen.

title: The Denial of Death
author: Ernest Becker
description: Winner of the Pulitzer Prize. Becker argues that the terror of death drives nearly everything humans do — our ambitions, our religions, our wars. A profound and unsettling synthesis of psychology, philosophy, and anthropology.

title: 21 Lessons for the 21st Century
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: From the author of Sapiens — a clear-eyed examination of the most pressing questions of our moment: AI, fake news, nationalism, religion, and how to stay sane in an age of bewildering change.

title: அரசியல் எனக்குப் பிடிக்கும்
author: ச.தமிழ்ச்செல்வன்
description: அரசு, அரசியல், ஆட்சி முறைகளை எளிய கலந்துரையாடல் நடையில் விளக்கும் நூல். இடதுசாரி, வலதுசாரி அரசியலின் வேறுபாடுகளை மார்க்சிய தத்துவ அடிப்படையில் சாதாரண மக்களுக்காக எழுதப்பட்ட சிறு நூல்.
